title: Genotyping protocol for detection of polymorphisms in the caprine PRNP gene
author: Loukia Ekateriniadou
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qeidtce
materials: KAPA PROBE FAST qPCR Master Mix (2X)

steps.title: Prepare qPCR master mix
steps.instruction: Combine 6.25 µl of 2X KAPA Probe FAST qPCR Master Mix, 0.3125 µl of 40X SNP Genotyping Assay Mix (primers and probes), 1 µl of genomic DNA (50–80 ng), and 4.9375 µl of nuclease‑free H₂O to a final volume of 12.5 µl per reaction.

substeps.instruction: Add 6.25 µl 2X KAPA Probe FAST qPCR Master Mix.
Add 0.3125 µl 40X SNP Genotyping Assay Mix.
Mix gently and briefly centrifuge to collect contents.

steps.title: Run qPCR thermal program
steps.instruction: Program the qPCR instrument for an initial denaturation at 95 °C for 3 min, then 45 cycles of 95 °C for 3 sec denaturation followed by 62 °C for 30 sec primer annealing/extension.

steps.title: Analyze genotypes
steps.instruction: Open the run file in Applied Biosystems StepOne Software version 2.3, view the amplification plots, and assign genotypes based on the observed fluorescence curves.
